class.name: NNNQSSearchCriteria
class.brief_description: Filter and score the nodes fetched using the search spaces.
class.description: The search criteria nodes are used to filter and score the nodes fetched using the search spaces. There are general criteria that can be used with any Godot node and specific criteria for 2D and 3D related search spaces. Each criterion has an internal [code]apply_criterion()[/code] method that is applied to the node passed to it. This method updates the [member is_filtered] and [member score] properties of the criterion and the results are visible in the Godot Engine editor inspector.

members.member: Optional [Curve] or [NNResponseCurve] that maps the criterion's raw [code]0..1[/code] score to the final score when [member use_for_scoring] is [code]true[/code]. Assigning any other resource type reports an error and keeps the previous curve.

Filter result for the last evaluated node, updated by [code]apply_criterion()[/code]. When [code]true[/code] and [member use_for_filtering] is enabled, the candidate node is excluded. Concrete criteria reset this to [code]false[/code] before evaluating each node.
Score calculated by [code]apply_criterion()[/code] for the last evaluated node. Concrete criteria reset this to [code]1.0[/code] before evaluating each node.
If [code]true[/code], candidate nodes for which this criterion sets [member is_filtered] to [code]true[/code] are excluded from the query results.
If [code]true[/code], this criterion's [member score] contributes to each surviving candidate node's score.
